title: Mutant Pink Slips
description: Mutant Pink Slips — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Agent Matt Roach

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 20 Mutant Fizzmaster Mixers and 20 Mutant Fizzmaster Guards in Algernon offs.

Quest Reward: 2500 Gold

Return to: Agent Illiot Fess

Repeatable: Yes

Following Quest: None

Last Build Updated: 155

Tip: To get the repeat on the quest, you must return to Agent Matt Roach.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Lay-off 20 Mutant Fizzmaster Mixers and 20 Mutant Fizzmaster Guards. When finished, report your progress to Agent Illiot Fess in Townston.

Offer:

It's about time that we struck at the production side of Capwn's Fizz Water operation. The mutants he has transporting the stuff need to be laid off. Find some of the Mutant Fizzmaster Guards and Mutant Fizzmaster Mixers scattered in the lower off-dungeons and let them know it's time to pack up and head home.

When you are finished, update Illiot Fess on your progress. He is up in Townston. And if you want, I'm sure we can do this again and again and again!

Turn-in:

Great work there, Runner. But it seems while you were coming up to see me, Agent Roach messaged that all the Mutants you laid off are already back on the job. You might want to go back and see him about giving more Pink Slips.

Objectives:

  • ''Laid-off'' Mutant Fizzmaster Mixers
  • ''Laid-off'' Mutant Fizzmaster Guards

Level range: 10–20
